title: One-step configuration update
statement: Let $z$ be a finite bit string, and consider a configuration with state $q$, input-head position $p$, two tape contents $v$ and $m$, both work heads at the integer position $j$, and output string $o$. For any input-head movement $i$ and local action $a$, if the machine transition on this configuration's scanned input symbol and the symbols on its two tapes equals the action encoded by $a$ with input movement $i$, then one machine step yields state and input-head position prescribed by $a$ and the clamped movement of $p$ by $i$; it updates the two tape contents at $j$ according to their respective writes, moves both work heads by the movement prescribed by $a$, and appends its optional output symbol to $o$.
hypotheses_covered: the transition at the given configuration equals the action encoded by $a$ and movement $i$
